keywords: In a partition action, parties agreed to abide by the court\'s decision following a judicial site inspection, whereupon the District Judge confirmed the Commissioner\'s scheme of partition. Held — where parties expressly consent to abide by a court\'s decision after a site inspection, there is an implied waiver of all defences and no statutory right of appeal lies against such an order; site inspection by a judge is permissible under Section 79 of the Partition Law No. 21 of 1977 read with the Civil Procedure Code; preliminary objection upheld and appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: Partition Law No. 21 of 1977 (Section 79); Civil Procedure Code
